title: Grade 3 Science — Mon, May 18
description: Human Body — Organs and Senses — Last Week Day 1
subject: science

questions.question: Which organ pumps blood around the body?
questions.explanation: The heart is a muscular organ that pumps blood through blood vessels to all parts of the body.

questions.question: How many senses does the human body have?
questions.explanation: The 5 senses are: sight, hearing, smell, taste, and touch.

questions.question: Which body part do we use to smell?
questions.explanation: The nose contains smell receptors (olfactory cells) that detect scents in the air.

questions.question: The brain is protected by the:
questions.explanation: The skull (cranium) is the hard bone case that protects the brain from injury.

questions.question: What is the job of the lungs?
options: Take in oxygen and release carbon dioxide
questions.explanation: Lungs are used for breathing — they take in oxygen from air and release carbon dioxide as a waste gas.

questions.question: Which organ controls everything the body does?
questions.explanation: The brain is the control centre of the body — it controls movement, thought, memory, and all body functions.

questions.question: Bones in the body form the:
questions.explanation: All bones in the body together form the skeleton. The skeleton supports the body and protects organs.

questions.question: How many bones are in the adult human body?
questions.explanation: An adult human body has 206 bones. Babies are born with about 270 — some fuse together as we grow.

questions.question: Which body part do we use for the sense of taste?
questions.explanation: The tongue has taste buds that detect sweet, salty, sour, bitter, and savoury (umami) tastes.

questions.question: What does the stomach do?
options: Breaks down food with acids and enzymes
questions.explanation: The stomach digests food using gastric acids and enzymes, breaking it into smaller pieces.

questions.question: Which sense helps us hear sounds?
questions.explanation: The ears collect sound waves and send signals to the brain. The inner ear converts vibrations to nerve signals.

questions.question: Muscles help the body to:
questions.explanation: Muscles contract and relax to create movement in the body — from walking to blinking.

questions.question: Which organ filters waste from the blood and makes urine?
questions.explanation: The kidneys filter waste products from blood and produce urine, which is stored in the bladder.

questions.question: What is the largest organ of the human body?
questions.explanation: The skin is the largest organ — it covers and protects the entire body, regulates temperature, and gives us the sense of touch.

questions.question: How can we keep our bones strong?
options: Eat calcium-rich foods (milk, cheese) and exercise
questions.explanation: Calcium (from milk, cheese, leafy greens) and weight-bearing exercise (walking, jumping) help keep bones strong.
